note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled at backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline with fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref). Every quotation is a verbatim OWB verse, range or shortest contiguous span, spliced by script; this replaces the 1962 UBS wording the first translation quoted (founder decision 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere).
A `mined` row means an exact substring of OWB Amharic Balanced, measured against the finished text. Citations keep the book names the Amharic library uses (1ኛ ቆሮንቶስ, ፊልጵስዩስ, ቲቶ, ሮሜ…).

Self-rendered: Titus 1:7 «የማይኮራ» glosses Luther's Vulgate "non superbus" (OWB's ግትር would not carry his "not haughty"); block 11's «ቢቻለኝ ኖሮ…» is Luther's own conditional restatement of 1 Cor 13:3 in OWB vocabulary; 1 Cor 15:28 in block 31 is Luther's paraphrase ("all in every soul").
